notes.title: Looking for native speakers
notes.notes:
Hi guys!
We order a translation into different languages, but sometimes it is not entirely correct, because native speakers do not play our game but see only the text. Because of this, problems arise - the player misunderstands the meaning of some phrases. If you would like to help us with translating, please write us your language and your conditions on which you could help :)

Our email: blazingplanetstudio@gmail.com
